what: M54 Phase 2 — finalization latency, baseline vs hardened (MEASURED, gateway client)
mechanisms: commit-landing at final (in-flight commit merged instead of discarded) + silence-tail fast path (final reuses the last hot decode) + remainder-only final decode
hindi_10min_decomposition: 6.5s = full-window final decode (fast path missed; speech to the cut) + ~3.0s hindi punctuation on 1795-1805 words (session telemetry punctuation_ms=3002)
outlier_class: the EN ~4s outlier (commit discarded at end, full re-decode) is structurally removed; 5 hardened boss30 runs: max 1.33s
fast_path_law: fires when only silence follows the last hot decode (pause-then-Stop, shorts, silence) — hello 181ms -> 52-60ms; does NOT fire when speech runs to the cut (battery clips), where the final is a bounded remainder decode
target_verdict: p95 <= 1s: MET for HI <= 2min and for EN long sessions and all shorts; MISSED (recorded, not relaxed) for EN boss30 (~1.2s) and HI 5-10min (1.4s / 6.5s, punctuation-dominated)
